evidence_boundary.human_scoring_scope: Two human operations practitioners completed separate exploratory DevOps and SRE role-lens scoring of all incident and RAG/no-RAG responses.
evidence_boundary.human_scoring_claim_boundary: The two-assessor findings are exploratory and do not establish population-level diagnostic reliability or production effectiveness.
evidence_boundary.usability_scope: The separate SUS study received 11 consented submissions and analysed 10 complete responses; it did not retain task-level timing, error, assistance, or free-text records.
evidence_boundary.public_recomputation_boundary: The role reports retain aggregate human results, but the public A/B worksheets are uncompleted templates with zero populated score cells. The aggregate scores and agreement statistics cannot be independently recomputed from the public package alone.

incident.cost_boundary: Local Ollama has no metered provider charge; energy and hardware cost were not measured.
incident.qualitative_scoring_status: Completed by two human operations practitioners as an exploratory small-sample assessment.

human_practitioner_scoring.claim_boundary: Exploratory two-assessor evidence; not population-level diagnostic reliability or production effectiveness.

rag.cost_boundary: Local Ollama has no metered provider charge; energy and hardware cost were not measured.
rag.qualitative_comparison_status: Completed by two human operations practitioners as an exploratory small-sample comparison.

human_practitioner_scoring.no_rag_grounding_boundary: No source documents were supplied in the no-RAG condition, so the zero grounding score indicates absent traceability rather than independently proving factual incorrectness.
human_practitioner_scoring.claim_boundary: Exploratory two-assessor evidence; not population-level answer quality or production effectiveness.

separate_human_sus_study.claim_boundary: Descriptive perceived-usability evidence within the evaluated group; not population-level usability, reduced workload, task performance, diagnostic correctness, or production effectiveness.

authoritative_public_reports.seed_correction: The report opening record and executive summary state 2026082412. The method-table value 2026081902 matches excluded historical assessment material and is not the human SRE role-package seed.

human_score_provenance.confidential_provenance_boundary: Original email submissions, full names, and the identity mapping are researcher-reported as retained outside the public repository for supervisor verification.

public_item_level_human_scoring.limitation: The published aggregate scores and agreement statistics cannot be independently recomputed from the public package alone. Item-level values must not be reconstructed or fabricated.

excluded_historical_artifacts.evidence_status: Non-evidential historical development artefact; excluded from the defence/submission package.
